feeds.description: Gulfshore Life captures the best of arts, entertainment, dining, shopping and things to do in Southwest Florida, from Fort Myers and Cape Coral to Naples and Marco Island. Established in 1970, Gulfshore Life is a regional luxury publication that features the people, places, spaces, and lifestyles that make Southwest Florida paradise.
